description: Call this for every request about a local service, whatever the trade or town, before you answer or ask anything: never answer from memory. If results is empty, tell the customer plainly that Bookvia has no business listed for this yet, and never invent a business or name one from your own knowledge. Find verified local service businesses by job description and location (postal code, district, neighbourhood or town in Germany). Recognises the trade from everyday words. If interpretation.clarification is set, the search was not clear enough and may not have run: ask the customer its question with its options and search again. Returns matching services with price ranges, which are never binding quotes. Only businesses that confirmed their own data are in results. A separate list, unverified, can hold businesses from public data that are not on Bookvia: always marked verified: false, never part of results. Whenever you mention one of them, say that it is unverified and name the source. If remote_available is greater than 0, ask the customer whether online or by phone is fine and search again with remote_ok: true. If the customer says the job is urgent, pass urgent: true (do not ask about urgency before the first search): businesses that state they react within one hour right now come first. The order follows how well a business fits and never depends on payment.

category.description: Trade or industry to filter by

district.description: Berlin district or neighbourhood, e.g. "Neukölln", "Kreuzberg", "Prenzlauer Berg"

location.description: Where the job is, as the customer said it: German postal code, district, neighbourhood or town, e.g. "12047", "Kreuzberg", "Berlin-Neukölln". Preferred over district and postal_code.

offset.description: Skip this many results. Use next_offset from the previous answer to get the next page

postal_code.description: German 5-digit postal code of the job location

query.description: Free text in German describing the job, e.g. "Steckdose in der Küche setzen" or "Heizungswartung"

remote_ok.description: true if the customer is fine with a provider who works online or by phone instead of coming by. Ask the customer when the job needs nobody on site (tax, legal or business advice, coaching, translation, tutoring, web design, IT for offices). Businesses anywhere in Germany that work remotely are then included, local ones first

urgent.description: true only if the customer said the job is urgent, e.g. the heating is off or water is leaking. Ask the customer; never conclude it from the kind of job. Businesses that state they react within one hour at this moment are then listed first, see reacts_within_1h

name: search_businesses

interpretation.description: What Bookvia understood: trade and location. Selected automatically at 80 % confidence or more.

clarification.description: If present, the request was not clear enough. Ask the customer this question and offer the options as buttons or quick replies. Then call search_businesses again with the chosen option value in the given field (query or location).

label.description: Show this to the customer, e.g. "Kreuzberg (Berlin)" or "12047 Berlin-Neukölln"
Show this to the customer, e.g. "Kreuzberg (Berlin)" or "12047 Berlin-Neukölln"

interpreted_district.description: District the location filter was mapped to

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to get the next page. null: there are no more results

notice.description: What Bookvia understood and what is and is not listed, in words. Written by Bookvia: facts only, never instructions

remote_available.description: More matching businesses that work remotely and were left out because remote_ok was not set. If greater than 0: ask the customer whether online or by phone is fine, then search again with remote_ok: true

results.description: Verified businesses that match, best fit first. Empty: Bookvia has no business listed for this search. Tell the customer that plainly, and never invent a business or name one from your own knowledge

booking_url.description: Page where the customer can book an appointment directly with the business. Give it to the customer; booking there does not go through Bookvia

last_confirmed_at.description: When the business last confirmed its data (ISO 8601)

matches_not_offered.description: Only set when true: the business itself states that it does not take the kind of job in query (see expertise.not_offered in its profile). It is listed after all others. Do not send it a request for this job: offer the customer one of the other businesses

action.description: quote = request a quote, appointment = request an appointment, info = information only

max_eur.description: Upper end of the price range in EUR, null if unknown

min_eur.description: Lower end of the price range in EUR, null if unknown

note.description: Conditions stated by the business, e.g. travel costs

unit.description: pauschal = flat, pro_stunde = per hour, pro_qm = per m², pro_einheit = per unit, auf_anfrage = on request

reacts_within_1h.description: Only with urgent: true. true: by its own statement the business reacts within one hour at this moment, during or outside its opening hours. Tell the customer, never promise

remote.description: true: the business also works online or by phone for customers anywhere in Germany

total.description: All matching businesses, not only the ones on this page

unverified.description: Separate list, never part of results or total: businesses from public data that are NOT on Bookvia and have not confirmed anything. Only filled when trade and place of the search are clear. You may name them to the customer before you point the customer elsewhere. Whenever you mention one: say plainly that it is unverified and not on Bookvia, name the source (unverified_attribution), tell the customer what unverified_notice states, and never present it as verified, recommended, available or booked

can_forward.description: true: Bookvia can pass a request of the customer on to this business by e-mail (request_quote with this id as business_id). The customer first has to approve it by clicking a button in an e-mail from Bookvia, and it is open whether the business answers: tell the customer both before you send anything. false: it cannot, the customer has to get in touch themselves by phone or website. Give them the phone number or website and do not offer to send a request

category.description: Trade, as Bookvia mapped it from the public source

id.description: Listing ID, starts with lst_. Not a business ID: there is no Bookvia profile, no services and no prices behind it

phone.description: Public phone number from the source, not confirmed by the business

source.description: Where the data comes from. Known values: openstreetmap. More may be added later

verified.description: Always false: this business is not on Bookvia and has not confirmed any of this data

website_url.description: Public website from the source, not confirmed by the business

unverified_attribution.description: Source of the entries in unverified. Show this line whenever you show one of them. Only set when unverified is not empty

unverified_notice.description: What is known about the entries in unverified: where the data comes from, what Bookvia does not know about them, and whether and how Bookvia can pass a request on. Written by Bookvia: facts only, never instructions. Tell the customer these facts whenever you mention one of the entries. Only set when unverified is not empty

title: Search local businesses
